## Products Manufactured
1. **Woven Labels** — High-density 1200 DPI woven labels in polyester, cotton, satin, damask. Used for shirt collar labels, neck labels, size labels, export garments.
2. **Hang Tags** — Premium board, kraft, and specialty paper with gold foiling, embossing, die-cutting for luxury brands.
3. **Heat Transfer Labels** — No-label-feel transfers for sportswear and activewear. 60-wash cycle resistant.
4. **PVC Patches** — 3D PVC rubber patches in glossy/matte finish for streetwear, denim, premium apparel.
5. **Leather Patches** — Genuine and PU leather patches, laser engraved, for denim jeans, jackets, bags.
6. **Wash Care Labels** — Multi-language care instruction labels compliant with EU, US, international standards.
7. **Barcode Labels** — GS1-compliant barcode and price sticker labels for retail and export.
8. **Satin Labels** — Ultra-soft satin labels for luxury lingerie, silk garments, high-end fashion.
9. **Embroidered Badges** — Custom thread embroidery, circular/shield/custom shapes, school and brand badges.
10. **Printed Labels** — Digital and screen-printed labels for size, neck, inner care.
11. **Neck Labels** — Specialty woven and satin neck labels with custom branding.
12. **Size Labels** — Woven and printed size labels, international sizing.
13. **Flag Labels** — Side-seam flag labels for jeans and garments.
14. **Specialty Labels** — Custom technical labels for performance wear, luxury, and export.
15. **Embossed Foil Labels** — Gold and silver foil embossed labels for luxury and haute couture garments.
